newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close weaker depressed by Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close weaker depressed by Ericsson.

text.p: Sweden's share market closed lower on Monday, slipping off Friday's highs, as telecoms giant Ericsson weighed the market down but banks posted strong gains.
The Stockholm general index slipped 0.21 percent to 2218.39 after shares worth 3.6 billion crowns were traded.
Ericsson tumbled 5.5 crowns to 200 crowns, reversing some of its gains last week when it hit an all-time high of 208 crowns.
The day's best performing sector was the banks with the sector index rising 3.63 percent, mainly on renewed speculation about S-E-Banken buying the state's holding of Nordbanken.
Nordbanken closed 9.5 crowns higher at 203 crowns, S-E-Banken climbed three to 62.50 crowns and Handelsbanken jumped nine to 181.5 crowns.
"It seems that the market is starting to factor a restructuring into the sector," one broker said.
Drugs major Astra was unchanged at 307 crowns.
Investment group Investor closed one lower at 268.5 crowns after posting nine-month results.
